title: Construct and characterize the rational-function place at infinity
statement: Let K be any field, M = FractionRing (Polynomial K) with its canonical K-algebra, and t the image of Polynomial.X. There exists a project place v∞ of M over K such that t does not belong to its valuation subring, v∞.deg = 1, and v∞.ord(a(t)) = −a.natDegree for every nonzero polynomial a ∈ K[T]. Moreover, every project place w whose valuation subring does not contain t equals v∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K], ∃ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K (FractionRing (Polynomial K)), algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) Polynomial.X ∉ v.toValuationSubring ∧ v.deg = 1 ∧ (∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → v.ord (algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) a) = -(a.natDegree : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K (FractionRing (Polynomial K)), algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) Polynomial.X ∉ w.toValuationSubring → w = v)
